title: Completed direct-image presentation comparison and finite cohomology profile
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, with its specified valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and let $d=(R,(\varpi))$ be the associated adic datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Use the ambient and complete operations of [lem-sbc-completed-operations-linear-natural-exchange]. For any morphism $f:V\to W$, define the direct-image presentation comparison $\mathsf P_f:Rf_*^{\mathrm{sbc}}\xrightarrow{\sim}d.\mathrm{push}(f)$ by applying the derived ringed-module direct-image functor to the equality of the two coefficient structure maps from [def-sf-completed-pullback-presentation-transport]. This equality is the one fixed by every finite quotient projection; the resulting isomorphism is the equality-to-isomorphism transport, not an arbitrary comparison. For any scheme $W$, level $n\in\mathbf N$, complex $J\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(R_{n,W}))$ and integers $a,b$, define $\mathsf{Profile}_{W,n}(J;a,b)$ to mean that for every $i\in\mathbf Z$, the constant-presentation finite cohomology sheaf $H^i_{n,W}(J)$ of [def-sf-adic-finite-cohomology] is constructible [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], and is zero if $i<a$ or $b<i$. Here $R_{n,W}$ denotes the function-coefficient sheaf for $R/(\varpi^{n+1})$. These are sfCompletedMatePushComparison and sfCompletedFiniteProfile. The definitions impose no properness, smoothness, nonempty scheme, nonnegative $a,b$, or relation $a\le b$, and do not assert that the profile holds.
